prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, style-transfer.
This is the single final substantive art revision. Image 1 is the existing portrait to revise; Images 2–5 are 8x nearest-neighbor enlargements of 74x100 style references. Follow their coarseness, connected facial planes and adult anatomy very strongly. Do NOT copy their identities or outfits.
Produce exactly one transparent head-and-narrow-collar portrait. Compose on a 74x100 LOGICAL pixel grid with large square clusters, no finer invented subpixel lines. The face, not the hair or clothing, should dominate. Face forehead-to-chin takes about 70 logical pixels. Top of complete hair at y=3, hairline at y=16–20, chin at y=86–88, only 3–5 pixels of short supporting neck and 6 pixels of collar below. The entire complete silhouette needs real 2–3 pixel transparent margins on left/right/top/bottom. A clear generous margin must actually surround the complete anatomy, not conceal clipped hair by adding a frame.
Required eye correction: reduce each eye opening vertically to a short dark slit, with tiny muted brown-grey sclera about one logical pixel only. NO white or cream eye blocks, NO shiny eyes, NO anime eye shape. Brightest eye color must be darker than cheek highlight. Use large nose and cheekbone light/shadow planes; no blur, no gradient, no painterly texture. At most 32 flat earthy colors, hard binary transparency. No text, border, props, scene, torso, shoulders or hands.
Subject: Yur, the same young adult male shepherd in his twenties as Image 1. Preserve warm sun-reddened skin, distinctive untidy walnut-brown hair, lean young-adult face, faint sparse brown jaw/chin stubble, visible ear and existing three-quarter angle. Keep firm closed skeptical mouth and alert proud not-yet-defeated expression. Do not age him, give him a thick beard, a hat, long mournful face or tragic raised inner brows.
Change composition dramatically: collapse the giant spiky hair crown by about one third and simplify to a few low uneven tousled locks; move the forehead/hairline higher while enlarging the broad exposed facial planes. Shorten the naked neck by at least two thirds. Delete the wide shoulder cape and chest entirely; leave only a thin brown rain-felt collar edge framing a small ochre wool neckline at the very bottom. Hair remains messy but not a giant headdress. Sparse stubble in two or three compact planes, not dot noise. Keep complete hair tips and ear fully in frame. Source clothing colors and personal identity stay unchanged.
